title: Apple reportedly won’t launch AirPods with cameras until next year.
summary: AirPods with cameras showed up in a video found in a release candidate of the upcoming macOS Tahoe 26.7 update, but Bloomberg reports that the headphones aren’t in the cards for 2026.
